title: 📢 KEA UGCET 2026 Round 1 Choice Selection & Fee Payment Portal Active
summary: KEA has activated the online Choice Selection portal for candidates allotted seats in Round 1 UGCET 2026. Candidates can choose between Choice 1 (Accept & Join), Choice 2 (Accept & Upgrade in R2), Choice 3 (Reject & Upgrade in R2), or Choice 4 (Reject & Exit). Online fee payment link and challan generation are live.

title: 🎉 KCET 2026 Round 1 Final Seat Allotment Results Declared
summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has officially published the final seat allotment results for UGCET 2026 Engineering, Architecture, and Agriculture courses. Candidates can log in with their CET No. to view allotment status and cutoffs.

title: ⚡ COMEDK 2026 Round 1 Seat Allotment & Decision Making Schedule
summary: COMEDK has released the Round 1 allotment decision making schedule. Candidates who are allotted seats must confirm their choice (Accept & Freeze or Accept & Upgrade) and pay tuition fees online before the deadline.

title: 📋 Important Document Reporting Guidelines for Choice 1 Candidates
summary: Candidates selecting Choice 1 must report to their respective allotted engineering/farm science colleges with original verification slip, marks cards, study certificates, caste/income certificates, and admission order.

title: 🏛️ VTU & Government Engineering Colleges Fee Concession Notice 2026
summary: Government engineering colleges across Karnataka offer 50% tuition fee concessions for eligible category candidates. Verification slip from KEA is mandatory during reporting.

title: 📊 KCET 2026 Mock Allotment & Cutoff Trend Analysis
summary: Analysis of 2026 mock allotment cutoffs shows steady demand in Computer Science, AI/ML, and Information Science branches across top Bengaluru and Mysuru engineering institutes.
